_note_filters: Gramado only (Juan's call 2026-09-01). entry_class is deliberately unfiltered: Rock in Rio does not check ticket type at the gate, so any class is usable and the cheapest one wins. Set extra.sector to null to watch all 6 sectors.
_note_rules: price_brl re-baselined 2026-09-01: 275.00 -> 230.00. The original 275.00 went DORMANT once the price fell under it — below_threshold is edge-triggered, so a ceiling above the current floor can never fire again. Set below the observed floor of R$ 250.00. Re-check whenever the record low moves.  price_changed fires on ANY move since the previous run (Juan's ask 2026-09-01). It is the noisiest rule by far — set direction to "down" to hear only about drops, or raise min_delta_brl to ignore churn.
